evidence: Selector 10 loads DUNGEON +0x186A800 into 0x80024000 for 0x6000 bytes.

entries.evidence: Selector 10 loads the bank at 0x80024000. Its header points to 0x80025090, followed by the zero word before the case table.
The flight sprite factory at DUNGEON +0x186a930 sets a random rotation and installs this callback. The callback advances a random number of frames and increments the parent spell's busy count.
The creator forms this callback at DUNGEON +0x186AC18 and stores it in the node update slot at +0x186AC20. The 108-byte body is identical at +0x10A7200 and +0x186AB74.
Selector 10 loads the twelve sectors from DUNGEON +0x186a800 to 0x80024000. The first word names the spell updater, which travels to its target and spawns a thirty-two sprite burst.
